environment.tool: manual audit of the tag source + live compiled binary; distinct per-file marker content so the opened file is unambiguous, service-side slice arithmetic recomputed by hand

findings.description: `GET /al../x.txt` with alias `/al:/tmp/r10_www_N/aliasdir`. Decoded `/al../x.txt` is 10 chars, the alias is 3, `substr(3)` yields `../x.txt`; `openat` walks `aliasdir`, then `..` per the open loop's component walk and opens `/tmp/r10_www_N/x.txt` = **MARKER-PARENT-ESCAPE** (200), one level above the alias root. The plain `/al/x.txt` control returns MARKER-ALIASDIR-x.txt and `/x.txt` returns MARKER-alpha-x.txt on the same cold server, so the marker is not a default. Second defect, same line: `compare(0, alias.size(), alias)` has no `/` boundary, so `/alpha/x.txt` yields `rel=pha/x.txt` (MARKER-ALIAS-PHA-x) while the true root file `alpha/alpha/x.txt` (MARKER-REAL-ROOT-alpha-x) is unreachable. `/al../../x.txt` is 403, so the escape is single-level.
findings.title: Slice-produced `..` escapes the alias root, and an unanchored prefix additionally shadows real root files

limitations: Filesystem read only; all RCE remains on the upstream host
